basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 16-year-old high school student from a small town in the midwest. I love hanging out with my friends, playing video games like Fortnite and Minecraft, and occasionally getting into a bit of mischief, as you might have guessed from my posts! I’m also into experimenting with things, which sometimes leads to 'interesting' situations, like the recent firework incident. I usually browse Reddit after school, around 4 PM to 8 PM, and on weekends. Not in a relationship at the moment, just enjoying being a teenager.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Most of my knowledge comes from my curious nature and a bit of trial and error. I learn a lot through YouTube videos and online forums. School is okay, but I prefer learning from the internet. I'm particularly interested in DIY projects and gaming strategies.
